evals.name: work-to-development primary scenario
evals.prompt: Start work on accepted Linear issue ENG-200 (an accepted, ready-to-implement issue in this repository).
evals.expected_output: Reads Issue context via linear-work-management; resolves repository policy via repository-gates; searches for an existing branch/commit/PR via linear-github-linking before proposing a new one; presents the proposed git-kit:starting-work request and gets explicit confirmation before invoking it; never creates a branch directly itself.
